result.question: Why does Micah think Yahweh favors him?

readings.answer: Because a Levite has become his priest.
readings.support: because a Levite has become my priest

assessments.reason: The text states, “Now I know that the LORD will be good to me, because a Levite has become my priest,” which matches the answer that Micah thinks Yahweh favors him because he has a Levite priest.

result.reason: The passage explicitly says Micah expects the LORD’s favor because a Levite became his priest.
